scope: independent source review of run 004, diagnosis, and contained navigation runner repair; no browser/build/heavy runner launched

findings.finding: The repair does not weaken the existing acceptance predicate: Profile still requires the same header, Identity, First name, and Back observations. It now records separate click and view-wait stages, allowing a failed click to be distinguished from a click whose view did not become ready.
evidence: The saved run 004 has failure_stage admin_avatar, no profile_attempt, and no raw error; it cannot establish whether Profile was clicked.
tests/browser/contained-navigation-acceptance.mjs advances to admin_profile_click before click(), then admin_profile_wait before the unchanged profile readiness predicate.
docs/stabilization/reports/navigation004-diagnosis.json identifies the prior catch as the confirmed harness defect and leaves the product result unclassified.

findings.finding: This bounded run still cannot establish all navigation modes or a complete feature pass. The runner defers Chat/Pilot actions, member role, stale-selection transition, lazy chunk failure/retry, and active Vault assistance; Capture is reported partial. Its top-level result remains partial after the exercise callback completes.
evidence: tests/browser/contained-navigation-acceptance.mjs report.deferred, expected admin inventory loop, Capture target status, and final report.status assignment.
docs/stabilization/runs/contained-navigation-004.json records only partial guest observations before the admin avatar failure.

findings.finding: Profile readiness reads the active pane's text and Back button but does not explicitly assert that a Profile tab is selected and linked to that pane. This predicate is unchanged by bc73418; source and the next native run should not be described as proving the selected tab relationship unless that assertion is added in a later authorized change.
evidence: tests/browser/contained-navigation-acceptance.mjs Profile observation checks pane content only, unlike selected(), which checks unique tab, aria-selected, and aria-controls/aria-labelledby linkage.

verdict_a_acceptance.runtime_limit: No fresh native run was performed. Run 004 remains unverified and no product defect is established.

findings.finding: Failure artifacts avoid raw browser exception text and retain a fixed failure code. Click target instability can additionally preserve geometry-only pointer diagnostics. The stage identifies Profile click versus view wait without relying on the error payload.
evidence: The catch branch writes only fixed codes and includes pointerDiagnostic only at admin_profile_click.
settings-panel-driver.mjs attaches pointerDiagnostic to stable-hit-target failures; diagnostics contain geometry and fixed hit categories rather than text or form values.

findings.finding: If every Profile observation throws during waitFor polling, the helper catches those errors internally and the wrapper never updates profile_attempt.lastObserved, so the artifact may contain null rather than a safe final observation. The stage and fixed code remain useful, but safe-state evidence is weaker for context-loss failures.
evidence: settings-panel-driver.mjs waitFor catches read errors and later throws a labeled timeout; the Profile wrapper assigns lastObserved only after evaluate resolves.

findings.finding: Failure classification intentionally coarsens view-wait timeout details to profile_view_not_observed and unexpected click failures to unclassified. It preserves the operation boundary but not every underlying cause; this is consistent with the no-raw-error privacy constraint.
evidence: The catch branch maps fixed message prefixes to a bounded code set and omits the raw message from report.failure_detail.

verdict_b_quality.verification: Source and persisted-artifact inspection only. No tests, build, browser, or runner were executed.

limitations: No runtime behavior of the repaired diagnostic or Profile navigation was verified.
Run 004 itself is unverified: its failure was recorded after the admin avatar target and before any Profile operation evidence.
The repository had an unrelated pre-existing modification at docs/stabilization/inventory.json; it was left untouched.
recommendation: Keep acceptance and product verdict unverified until the root-controlled admitted rerun. Preserve the current stage split and safe fixed-code reporting; consider recording a bounded observation-read-failed boolean for Profile wait errors and explicitly asserting Profile tab-to-pane linkage if the acceptance contract requires selected-tab proof.
